item.title: Young South African stars making waves in England’s football academies
item.description: Manchester United's Elyh Harrison, who is eligible to play for Bafana Bafana through his South African mother, saves a penalty during an EFL Trophy match against Stockport County in August 2023..

item.title: Midnight Avenue: rising Durban band gears up for their first major release
item.description: Midnight Avenue is a youth alternative rock band from Chatsworth, Durban, made up of five members brought together by a shared love for live music and honest expression.

item.title: Ocean View's Christmas celebration brings joy to over 400 children
item.description: Nadia Petersen of the Groundbreakers nonprofit helps hand out gifts during a Christmas celebration for children in Ocean View last week, where festive decorations, games and donated presents brought moments of joy to more than 400 children ahead of Christmas.

item.title: Christmas Eve Weather: SA braces for widespread showers and storms
item.description: Heavy rainfall and lightning are expected in various regions on Wednesday.

item.title: Judge upholds Trump's $100k fee to process US tech visas
item.description: A US federal judge on Tuesday upheld President Donald Trump's $100,000 fee to process H-1B visa applications, acknowledging it could &quot;inflict significant harm on American businesses and institutions of higher education.&quot;

item.title: We Buy Cars to pay R2.5m fine, R3.4m in refunds
item.description: We Buy Cars has been fined R2.5 million and ordered to refund more than R3.4 million to 31 consumers after an investigation by the National Consumer Commission found its sales terms contravened consumer protection legislation.

item.title: Bafana Bafana’s Hugo Broos weighs centre-back options ahead of Egypt clash
item.description: Bafana Bafana will be looking to find the perfect partner for Mbekezeli Mbokazi in the heart of defence ahead of their AFCON match against Egypt.

item.title: Venus Williams ties the knot with Andrea Preti in a modern-day fairytale wedding
item.description: The wedding of Venus Williams and Andrea Preti is more than an addition to celebrity romance; it’s a testament to a love that inspires.

item.title: Two Russian police officers killed in Moscow blast near site of general’s assassination
item.description: In this handout photo released by the Russian Investigative Committee on December 22, 2025, an investigator works at the car bomb site in southern Moscow.

item.title: DJ Warras murder: Two alleged killers in court amid police investigation into targeted attack
item.description: Two suspects charged with the murder of media personality Warrick Stock, known as DJ Warras, are expected to appear in the Johannesburg Magistrates’ Court on December 24, 2025, following his fatal shooting outside Zambesi House in the city’s CBD.
